ช่วงก่อนเปลี่ยนอาชีพใช้ของเดิมได้ เก็บเง: Keep your current equipment before job advancement and save for a Lv.10 weapon.
กรงเล็บต้องใช้คู่กับดาวกระจาย เทียบ W.AT: Claws must be used with throwing stars. Compare their combined W.ATK. Stars do not unlock at Lv.15 / 20 / 25 like claws, and shields cannot be used with claws.
เลือกเลเวลจริงของคุณเพื่อดูชุดที่น่าใช้: Select your actual level to see suggested equipment. The values below are base stats for unscrolled items. You must meet both the level and stat requirements for each item.
มีของที่สกอลล์แล้วให้เทียบค่าจริงก่อนซื้: If you own scrolled equipment, compare its actual stats before buying. Higher-level equipment is not always better, and the listed stat requirements do not mean you should change your AP build to match them.

เริ่มจากของที่ใส่ได้ตามสเตตัส ยังไม่ต้อง: Start with equipment your stats allow. You do not need to buy every piece if your current gear handles monsters comfortably.
หมวกยังเพิ่ม LUK เท่าเดิม เปลี่ยนเมื่ออย: The hat gives the same LUK. Upgrade for defense if needed; it is not an immediate purchase priority.
ชุดช่วงนี้เพิ่ม LUK +2 ต่อชิ้น เป็นจุดที: Equipment at this stage gives LUK +2 per piece. Compare it with your Lv.10–15 gear.
ชุดหญิง Dark Sneak เพิ่ม LUK +2 แต่เสื้อ: The female Dark Sneak set gives LUK +2, but the male Black Sneak top gives DEX +1 / LUK +1. You can keep Black Pao for its LUK +2. The new bottoms still give LUK +2, with more defense.
ชุดชาย Black Knucklevest เพิ่ม LUK +3 ต่: The male Black Knucklevest set gives LUK +3 per piece. Female characters can keep the recommended Dark Sneak set.
Dark Shadow เพิ่ม LUK +4 ต่อชิ้น เทียบค่: Dark Shadow gives LUK +4 per piece. Compare actual stats with your scrolled equipment before switching.
เก็บ Dark Shadow Lv.40 ใช้ต่อได้ ไม่จำเป: You can keep your Lv.40 Dark Shadow set. There is no need to buy Lv.50 gear if it lowers your LUK; spending that money on a weapon may be more worthwhile.
ดู M.ATK ของไม้เท้าและ INT ของชุดเป็นหลั: Focus on the weapon's M.ATK and the equipment's INT. W.ATK is not magic attack.
Blue Plain Robe เป็นชุดเต็มตัว จึงใช้แทน: Blue Plain Robe is an overall, replacing both your top and bottoms.
เสื้อและท่อนล่างเพิ่ม INT +2 ต่อชิ้น รวม: The top and bottoms each give INT +2, for a total of +4 when worn together.
Blue Doros / Brown Doroness เพิ่ม INT +5: Blue Doros / Brown Doroness give INT +5 and are overalls, replacing both top and bottoms.
หมวก Brown Jester เพิ่ม INT +3 ชุดชาย Bl: Brown Jester gives INT +3. The male Blue Wizard Robe gives INT +6, while female characters can keep Doroness.
Blue Chaos Robe ยังเพิ่ม INT +6 เท่า Blu: Blue Chaos Robe still gives INT +6, the same as Blue Wizard Robe. Upgrade for defense or MP if useful, but there is no rush to buy it.
Blue Starlight / Blue Moonlight เพิ่ม IN: Blue Starlight / Blue Moonlight give INT +8. Keep using Wizard if you do not have a weapon with better M.ATK.
Cromi เป็นจุดเปลี่ยนไม้เท้าถัดไป ชุดเต็ม: Cromi is the next weapon upgrade. The overall gives INT +10. Check the LUK requirements before buying.
ซื้อ Pole Arm ก่อนเป็นอย่างแรก ชุด Lv.10: Buy Pole Arm first. Harry's Lv.10 equipment in Perion is optional. If funds are limited, save for the Lv.15 set instead.
ชุด Lv.15 ของ Harry รวมราว 9,000 meso ช่: Harry's Lv.15 set costs about 9,000 meso in total and can substantially reduce potion costs. Iron Ball requires 15 DEX including equipment; you can equip it around level 17.
หมวกและรองเท้า DEX +2 ทำให้ถึงเกณฑ์ DEX: The hat and shoes give DEX +2, helping meet the next polearm's DEX requirement. Red Kendo Robe is optional; you can keep the Lv.15 set.
Mithril War Boots ได้ฟรีจากเควสของ Nella: Mithril War Boots are a free reward from Nella's QUEST. Janitor's Mop can be crafted at Weaponcrafting 5. If you do not have it, keep your current weapon.
Mithril Pole Arm คืออัปเกรดที่คุ้มที่สุด: Mithril Pole Arm is the best-value upgrade at this stage. Buy it from players for around 15,800 meso. You can keep your current armor.
ชุด STR +6 เป็นตัวเลือก ถ้างบไม่พอใช้ Sa: The STR +6 set is optional. If funds are limited, use the QUEST reward Sauna Robe or keep your current equipment.
Steel Nordic Helm ได้ฟรีจากเควส Cursed D: Steel Nordic Helm is a free reward from the Cursed Dolls QUEST. Craft Crescent Polearm at Weaponcrafting 8 or buy it from players.
Bronze Crusader Helm ได้จากเควสของ Luke: Bronze Crusader Helm is a reward from Luke's QUEST and is optional. The Nine Dragons is drop-only. If it is expensive, keep Crescent Polearm.
ซื้อ Metal Axe ก่อนเป็นอย่างแรก ชุด Lv.1: Buy Metal Axe first. Harry's Lv.10 equipment in Perion is optional. If funds are limited, save for the Lv.15 set instead.
ชุด Lv.15 ของ Harry รวมราว 9,000 meso ช่: Harry's Lv.15 set costs about 9,000 meso in total and can substantially reduce potion costs. There is no Lv.15 two-handed axe, so keep Metal Axe.
หมวกและรองเท้า DEX +2 ทำให้ DEX ถึง 25 พ: The hat and shoes give DEX +2, bringing DEX to 25 for Two-Handed Axe. Iron Axe has only 5 more attack than Metal Axe, so you do not need to buy it.
Two-Handed Axe แรงกว่า Metal Axe 15 ใช้ไ: Two-Handed Axe has 15 more attack than Metal Axe and can last until level 35. Players sell it for around 10,000 meso, less than the NPC price. Mithril War Boots are a free reward from Nella's QUEST.
ใช้ Two-Handed Axe ต่อ Blue Axe (Lv.30): Keep Two-Handed Axe. Blue Axe (Lv.30) is rarely listed for sale, so you do not need to search for it. You can keep your current armor.
Niam คืออัปเกรดใหญ่ของช่วงนี้ คราฟต์ด้วย: Niam is the major upgrade at this stage. Craft it at Weaponcrafting 7 or buy it from players. The STR +6 set is optional.
Steel Nordic Helm ได้ฟรีจากเควส Cursed D: Steel Nordic Helm is a free reward from the Cursed Dolls QUEST. Craft Sabretooth at Weaponcrafting 8 or buy it from players.
Bronze Crusader Helm ได้จากเควสของ Luke: Bronze Crusader Helm is a reward from Luke's QUEST and is optional. The Rising is drop-only. If it is expensive, keep Sabretooth.
ซื้อ Wooden Mallet ก่อนเป็นอย่างแรก ชุด: Buy Wooden Mallet first. Harry's Lv.10 equipment in Perion is optional. If funds are limited, save for the Lv.15 set instead.
ชุด Lv.15 ของ Harry รวมราว 9,000 meso ช่: Harry's Lv.15 set costs about 9,000 meso in total and can substantially reduce potion costs. Heavy Mace is too expensive, so keep Wooden Mallet until level 20.
Square Hammer แรงกว่า Wooden Mallet 10 ต: Square Hammer has 10 more attack than Wooden Mallet and requires 20 DEX. A hat or shoes with DEX +2 will help you meet the requirement.
Monkey Wrench คราฟต์ด้วย Weaponcrafting: Craft Monkey Wrench at Weaponcrafting 5. If you have not trained the skill, keep Square Hammer. Mithril War Boots are a free reward from Nella's QUEST.
Mithril Maul ซื้อจากผู้เล่นราว 15,000 me: Buy Mithril Maul from players for around 15,000 meso. It requires 30 DEX. You can keep your current armor.
Sledgehammer คืออัปเกรดใหญ่ของช่วงนี้ คร: Sledgehammer is the major upgrade at this stage. Craft it at Weaponcrafting 7 or buy it from players. The STR +6 set is optional.
Steel Nordic Helm ได้ฟรีจากเควส Cursed D: Steel Nordic Helm is a free reward from the Cursed Dolls QUEST. Craft Titan at Weaponcrafting 8 or buy it from players.
Bronze Crusader Helm ได้จากเควสของ Luke: Bronze Crusader Helm is a reward from Luke's QUEST and is optional. Golden Mole is drop-only. If it is expensive, keep Titan.
Beginner's War Bow (ATK 29) ที่ได้ตอนเปล: The Beginner's War Bow (ATK 29) received at job advancement has only 1 less attack than the shop's War Bow, so do not buy another. Spend the money on arrows and Sam's Lv.10 equipment instead.
Composite Bow ต้องมี STR 15 ซึ่งแผน AP น: Composite Bow requires 15 STR, which this AP plan reaches at level 15. Buy armor from Sam in Henesys. Female characters use Green Able Armor with Green Able Armor Skirt.
Hunter's Bow (ATK 42) แรงกว่า Composite: Hunter's Bow (ATK 42) has 7 more attack than Composite Bow and is worth its 13,500 meso price. Sam's Lv.20 equipment adds about 5 DEX in total.
Battle Bow (ATK 44) ยิงเร็วขึ้นหนึ่งขั้น: Battle Bow (ATK 44) is one attack-speed tier faster but is optional. You can keep Hunter's Bow and save to craft Ryden at level 30. Brown Jack Boots are a reward from Nella's QUEST chain.
Ryden ไม่มีขายจาก NPC แล้ว คราฟต์ด้วย Wo: Ryden is no longer sold by NPCs. Craft it at Woodcrafting Lv.6 or buy it from players. Until then, you can keep Hunter's Bow. Most Lv.30 armor must be obtained from drops or crafting, so keeping your Lv.25 set is fine.
Red Viper ต้องใช้ Woodcrafting Lv.7 ถ้าค: Red Viper requires Woodcrafting Lv.7. If you cannot craft it, keep Ryden until level 40. You can obtain Sauna Robe at level 37 and wear it instead of a top and bottoms.
Vaulter 2000 ต้องใช้ Woodcrafting Lv.8 แ: Vaulter 2000 requires Woodcrafting Lv.8 and 40 Drake Skulls. If you cannot craft it, buy it from players or keep your current weapon.
Olympus (Lv.50) ดรอปจากมอนเท่านั้น ถ้าไม: Olympus (Lv.50) is only obtained from monster drops. If you cannot find one, keep Vaulter 2000.
ใช้ Beginner's War Bow ที่ได้ฟรีไปก่อน c: Use the free Beginner's War Bow for now. The first crossbow worth buying is Battle Crossbow at level 15. First-job skills work with both bows and crossbows.
Battle Crossbow ไม่ต้องใช้ STR ใส่ได้ทัน: Battle Crossbow has no STR requirement and can be equipped at level 15. Switch to Arrows for Crossbows as well. Female characters use Green Able Armor with Green Able Armor Skirt.
Balanche (ATK 39) แรงกว่า Battle Crossbo: Balanche (ATK 39) has only 2 more attack than Battle Crossbow. Save for Mountain Crossbow (ATK 47) at level 25 instead. Sam's Lv.20 equipment adds about 5 DEX in total.
Mountain Crossbow (ATK 47) แรงกว่า Battl: Mountain Crossbow (ATK 47) has 10 more attack than Battle Crossbow. Buy it from Karl for 16,500 meso. Brown Jack Boots are a reward from Nella's QUEST chain.
Eagle Crow ไม่มีขายจาก NPC แล้ว คราฟต์ด้: Eagle Crow is no longer sold by NPCs. Craft it at Woodcrafting Lv.6 or buy it from players. Until then, keep Mountain Crossbow; the ATK difference is only 5.
crossbow เลเวล 35 ไม่มีให้ซื้อหรือคราฟต์: There is no Lv.35 crossbow available to buy or craft. Keep Eagle Crow until level 40. You can obtain Sauna Robe at level 37 and wear it instead of a top and bottoms.
Heckler ต้องใช้ Woodcrafting Lv.8 และยิง: Heckler requires Woodcrafting Lv.8 and fires faster than other crossbows (Normal speed). If you cannot craft it, buy it from players or keep Eagle Crow.
Silver Crow (Lv.45) และ Rower (Lv.50) ดร: Silver Crow (Lv.45) and Rower (Lv.50) are only obtained from monster drops. If you cannot find them, keep Heckler.
Nimble Wristguard เป็นโล่โจร Lv.22 ใช้กั: Nimble Wristguard is a Lv.22 thief shield that can be used with daggers. It adds defense, not LUK.
เน้นเทียบพลังโจมตีของอาวุธกับชิ้นเดิม โด: Compare the weapon's attack with your current weapon, especially if yours has been scrolled.
เริ่มใหม่: ลง STR ก่อน Lv.10 → เดินรับ L: Starting fresh: add STR before Lv.10 → unlock Life Skills while Beginner Taxi fares still apply → advance to Warrior in Perion → choose
กด Route หลักเพื่อเดินต่อ รายการของห้ามข: Open the main Route to continue. Use the items-to-keep button to see what you should not sell.
เปิดแผนประหยัดยาทุกเลเวล: Open the potion-saving plan for every level
· รวม 121 SP ก่อนแต้มหลังเปลี่ยนขั้นสาม: · 121 SP in total, before points awarded after third-job advancement
หลัง Mastery: Lv.39–47 Rage +3 ต่อเลเวล;: After Mastery: Lv.39–47, add Rage +3 per level; Lv.48, Rage +2 / Final Attack +1; Lv.49–57, Final Attack +3 per level; Lv.58–70, return to the main plan. The final total remains 121 SP. Choose one plan before spending points; do not add both plans together.
ถ้าต้องการสองอาวุธตั้งแต่ขั้นสอง: If you want to use two weapon types from second job
ทางเลือกยอดจบ Mastery 20/20, Booster 10/: Alternative final totals: Mastery 20/20, Booster 10/10, main-weapon Final Attack 30, Threaten 16, and Rush 15, totaling 121 SP. The trade-offs are shorter buffs and non-maxed Rush. The secondary weapon can use single-target and group attacks, but cannot use the other weapon family's Final Attack. This plan suits players who already have both weapon types ready.
